exposure: age of initiation of antiviral therapy
cohort: Untreated children with chronic hepatitis B attributed to mother-to-child transmission.
finding: Asymptomatic ALT flares were frequent in preschool-aged children with mother-to-child transmitted chronic hepatitis B, and early initiation of antiviral therapy, particularly before 6.2 years of age, significantly increased the probability of therapy-induced HBsAg loss.
followup_time: median 14.6 months (range 0.1-177.1 months) for spontaneous ALT flares, and median 19.3 months (range 6.5-56.2 months) for therapy-induced HBsAg loss.
